user_architecture_adaptation.typed_residual_object: R(F) owns its signed incidence coordinates, local type partition and unresolved CNF residual rather than being treated only as bytes.
user_architecture_adaptation.relax: Perform existing proof-preserving local simplification, then type the residual in its own coordinates.
user_architecture_adaptation.aggregate: Meet at a fixed identity-erasure boundary only when the registered typing rule yields an unambiguous anchor order.
user_architecture_adaptation.close: Rename by the anchor order and require exact canonical-CNF equality before Boolean reuse.
user_architecture_adaptation.orthogonal_gauge_fixing_adaptation: Use deterministic anchor conservation/canonical ordering as a gauge metaphor; do not use statistical orthogonality as SAT soundness.
user_architecture_adaptation.proof_preserving_rule: Q(F)=Q(G) is a reuse license only with an explicit variable permutation whose application makes the residual CNFs exactly equal.
user_architecture_adaptation.witness_recovery_rule: Store/invert the permutation so a canonical satisfying assignment can be lifted back to the original coordinates.
